headline: US futures point to a modestly higher open as traders await October CPI data and react to earnings-driven stock moves
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) rise 0.19%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) climb 0.47%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) edge lower by 0.01%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) gain 0.35%, indicating relative strength in value and small caps
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat pre-market after raising its annual sales and profit forecasts on resilient demand for premium skincare and fragrances
- Rivian (RIVN) slips about 0.2% after UBS (UBS) upgrades the stock to Buy with a $17 price target
- Check Point Software (CHKP) trades roughly flat in pre-market trading after issuing a weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue forecast
- TransDigm Group (TDG) reports earnings before the bell alongside On Holding (ONON) and other names
- October CPI is due at 8:30 AM ET and is expected to be the primary catalyst for intraday volatility
- European shares advance in their session while major Asian markets trade mixed overnight
